metadata.title: Athletic Noir Portrait with Integrated Equipment Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a woman standing against a deep black background, wearing minimalist black athletic wear and oversized white ice hockey goalie pads. The pads serve as the primary canvas for vertical, textured typography that follows the physical contours of the equipment.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between soft human skin tones and the hard, segmented geometry of the goalie pads.
Vertical alignment of the subject and the stacked lettering on the equipment.
Isolation of the subject through extreme negative space and low-key lighting.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and analog texture
Subject wearing white hockey goalie pads
Vertical text orientation on the pads

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full body, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white goalie pads at the base of the composition, providing a high-contrast foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the torso to the high-contrast pads, then follows the vertical text upward/downward on each leg.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject on all sides, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Matte black background and clothing providing a dark canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey of the hockey equipment.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sparkling cobalt blue used for the lettering fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white pads and black background.

letterConstructionRules: Distortion to match the padded segments of the equipment
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are broken across the horizontal seams of the goalie pads

composition.position: centered on the front face of each goalie pad
composition.scale: large, spanning the height of the shin guard
composition.warp: conformed to the cylindrical and segmented surface of the pads

treatment.outline: thin black stroke for legibility against white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two vertical columns to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary bold, condensed skeleton for the vertical stack.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photo of a woman in black athletic wear and white hockey goalie pads against a pure black background. Use warm, soft lighting on the subject and apply a heavy 35mm film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, all-caps text to the front of the goalie pads. The text should be a bold condensed sans-serif with a blue rhinestone texture, segmented to look like it is printed across the horizontal seams of the pads.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black with visible grain?
Does the text follow the physical segments of the hockey pads?
Is the lighting low-key with soft fall-off on the skin?
Is the text vertically stacked and centered on each leg?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the hockey equipment

mustAchieve: Realistic integration of text onto the 3D surface of the pads
avoid: Perfectly clean vector text that doesn't respect the pad's seams

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks like it is physically part of the equipment.
Check that the film grain is consistent across the subject and background.
Verify that the blue texture has a 'sparkle' or 'rhinestone' quality.
Confirm the composition remains vertically centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + sports equipment + vertical segmented typography + low-key lighting + heavy film grain.
